findings.issue: F4 facet concurrence: The PAT dispatch fires the downstream workflow without passing the staging SHA that was just promoted. The downstream job later reads the live staging ref and promotes whatever SHA is present at execution time, so replay or a closely spaced staging update can…
findings.remediation: Add a workflow_dispatch input such as expected_staging_sha, pass the promoted SHA from the dev-to-staging step, and have promote-staging-to-production refuse to PATCH production unless the live staging ref still matches that expected SHA.
